description: Speech to text (Whisper large v3 turbo). Send a public audio/video URL or base64 audio (max 20 MB); get the transcript, detected language, timed segments and WebVTT subtitles. Priced by length: $0.002 + $0.0015 per minute of max_minutes (default 6, up to 30). Costs $0.047 USDC per call (x402).
